copy.curiosityHook: With no memory of his real past, can the stranded agent untangle his identity before the conspirators who betrayed him close in?
copy.description: After a corrupt CIA agent causes a devastating helicopter crash in South Africa, an amnesiac commando is nursed by a local tribe and must piece together his forgotten identity alongside an enigmatic reporter.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting, and lightly comic, delivering brisk action-adventure thrills with an engaging mystery.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan and Benny Chan, this fast-paced action-comedy combines globe-trotting intrigue and physical stunts with lighthearted suspense that keeps you engaged.
